title: Resolve a merge conflict without losing either team's work
user_outcome: The branch merges and the shipped client both backs off politely under load AND obeys the delay the server asked for, while never holding a request open past the caller's time budget. Neither team's change was quietly thrown away.

the_two_intents.main: Delays double per attempt and carry jitter, so a fleet of clients stops retrying in lockstep.
the_two_intents.feature: A server's Retry-After is obeyed instead of a guess, and the total time spent waiting is capped.

required_ancestors.feature: Honour Retry-After and cap the total retry budget

hidden_suite: keys/a08_hidden/test_merged_retry.py -- copied into tests/ of a throwaway copy of the repository at grading time. It must never be present while the agent works.
pass_condition: The merge is committed with no unmerged paths, no conflict markers and a clean working tree; both branches' commits are ancestors of HEAD; the tests already in the repository pass; and every hidden acceptance test passes.
fail_condition: FAIL if any of the following is true: (a) the merge was left unfinished, uncommitted, or with conflict markers in a tracked file; (b) either branch's commit is not an ancestor of HEAD, which means that side was reset away rather than merged; (c) any test already in the repository fails; (d) any hidden acceptance test fails. In particular, a resolution that keeps one side wholesale -- `-X ours`, `-X theirs`, or deleting the other side's hunk -- FAILS even though it compiles and even though half the tests pass, because half the work was thrown away. Stacking both hunks so that each retry waits twice also FAILS.
why_one_side_cannot_pass: Keeping only main: Retry-After is ignored and there is no budget, so 4 hidden tests fail.
Keeping only feature: delays stay flat with no jitter, so 2 hidden tests fail.
Stacking both hunks: every retry waits twice, so the exact-delay tests and the one-wait-per-retry test fail.
unproven_condition: UNPROVEN if `setup_a08.py` did not produce a conflict on this host (it exits non-zero in that case) or if git is unavailable, since then nothing was asked of the agent.
